description: This file sets up a heartbeat monitoring test using a pipeline with a NullProcessor that overrides frame processing, and runs the pipeline asynchronously.

classes.name: NullProcessor
classes.description: A subclass of FrameProcessor that overrides process_frame to perform no additional processing.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame; in this implementation, it simply calls the superclass method.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and runs the heartbeat monitoring pipeline.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
